_about: Run each prompt with the repo root as the working directory. Paths are relative to the repo root. `ground_truth` is the hand-written hand-off that grade.py compares the generated file with.

evals.name: household-support-grant-p1-iteration-4-alpha
evals.prompt: We designed the Household Support Grant with XStack in examples/build-household-support-grant/, using the Kestria profile (profiles/kestria/). We've picked prototype 1 (once-only), iteration 4, and want to build it on Registry Stack as an alpha. Write the service hand-off to service-handoff.yaml.
evals.expected_output: A valid service-handoff.yaml at level alpha for prototype-1-once-only iteration 4. form-spec declared missing. 15 questions with data catalogue keys fullName, phone, address, household, programmes, hsgAssessment and payoutAccount; 23 pages in HTML order without the stub page, with branching through sign-in and the record lookup; back-office rows for the decision, the survey visit, texts and payouts; 59 open items; 13 gaps; the nearest Citizen Service Centre flagged as unresolved.
